purpose: Exact draft approval/deploy/evidence packet for the current ABI-compatible mainnet spend-program evidence tranche. This packet does not approve funds, deploy programs, run live transactions, write approval evidence, write settlement evidence, or claim production privacy.

canonicalSource.artifactBuildCommitPurpose: Fresh local current-ABI SBF artifact build and production-evidence next-blocker status
canonicalSource.postPacketCommitPolicy: Later commits may update this packet, but the local artifact hash in this packet is tied to artifactBuildCommit.

knownBuildWarnings: Host and SBF builds emit deprecated solana_program system instruction/program warnings.
Host and SBF builds emit unused reserved helper/constant warnings.
SBF post-processing warns about unresolved syscall symbols; repo ABI and lineage gates still pass.

proposedApprovalRecord.proposedActionSummary: One Vanta mainnet-beta current-ABI Private Pool v2 spend-program deploy or upgrade, reinitialize/smoke account setup, and actual-private shared-cohort settlement evidence run with maximum 2.0 SOL at risk
proposedApprovalRecord.maximumFundsAtRiskRationale: Includes current SBF program deploy or upgrade rent/fees, smoke account rent, settlement fees, and a buffer. The older 0.015 SOL approval cap is not sufficient for deploy or upgrade work.

actions: Stop all live Private Pool v2 browser and operator actions.
Disable or remove production service routes that can call the deployed spend program.
Keep the deployed program address and every transaction signature in evidence for review.
Do not rerun deploy, smoke, settlement, or evidence-write commands without a new bounded approval window.

stopConditions: Stop before approval if git status is dirty with unreviewed changes.
Stop before approval if the SBF artifact sha256 differs from ff128d4a8169c95a67cf25cd895d8b328cff4607704ee0dc3d57276f10bca91d.
Stop before approval if npm run private-pool-v2:sbf-abi-check fails.
Stop before approval if npm run zk:c01-sbf-live-lineage-acceptance-gate-check fails.
Stop before any live command if npm run mainnet:production-evidence-next-check fails.
Stop before any live command if no fresh Clay approval exists for the exact action ref, launch window, fee payer ref, and 2.0 SOL cap.
Stop before any live command if the estimated deploy, upgrade, smoke, and settlement cost exceeds 2.0 SOL.
Stop immediately if any command asks to paste a private key, seed phrase, raw bearer token, raw database URL, signed transaction, or customer private input into chat or git.
Stop after one failed live transaction, failed live preflight, replay invariant failure, unexpected public linkage, or missing reviewer-packet invariant.
Stop after any successful deploy or upgrade plus evidence run; no retries or extra live funds without a new bounded approval window.
